sources.role: pinned Windows source for Preferences.cfg, input, state and resource paths

paths.path: %USERPROFILE%\Documents\BeebEm\Preferences.cfg by default (UserDataFolder/ -Data / -CustomData can override the root)
paths.naming: Custom token/key=value text format; CMOSRam and CMOSRamMasterET are stored in Preferences.cfg

paths.path: Preferences.cfg plus optional user key-map files selected by UserKeyMapFile
paths.naming: Sticks=Disabled|Joystick|AnalogueMouseStick|DigitalMouseStick is persisted; WinMM JOYSTICKID1 is runtime-only and no physical device id is saved

paths.path: Default data root contains DiscIms/ for bundled or user-selected .ssd/.dsd/.adl/.img media; guest saves are written into attached images
paths.naming: Guest filing-system names; host image names are user-selected

paths.path: Default data root BeebState\quicksave.uefstate; numbered quick saves use quicksaveN.uefstate; user state paths are selected by the frontend
paths.naming: .uefstate BeebState format; quicksave and quicksaveN are the built-in slot names

paths.path: Default data root BeebFile\ (model-specific ROM tree), with ROM selection persisted in Roms.cfg
paths.naming: Model/subsystem filenames are source resource names; no universal checksum asserted
